newsitem.title: USA: Lehman's Bauer to co-head CSFB U.S. bond sales.
newsitem.headline: Lehman's Bauer to co-head CSFB U.S. bond sales.

text.p: David Bauer, formerly a managing director and producing high-yield sales manager at Lehman Brothers Inc, has left to become a co-head of U.S. fixed-income sales at Credit Suisse First Boston, a CSFB spokeswoman confirmed.
Bauer will join Doug Paul and Wes Higgins as co-heads of U.S. fixed-income sales. All three will report to Marc Hotimsky, head of fixed-income at CSFB, who is based in London, she said.
The spokeswoman said futher information was not immediately available.

Lehman has appointed Robert Burke as the new producing manager of high-yield sales. He will report to Tom Bernard who heads Lehman's high-yield department. Burke was formerly a high-yield salesman at Lehman.
CSFB is the U.S. investment banking unit of Zurich-based Credit Suisse Group.
